control-objectives.description: Device boots only signed firmware. No unsigned firmware accepted at boot.
Every telemetry frame is signed (Ed25519, RFC-8785 JCS canonical) before transmission.
Physical tamper cap triggers physical-key reset on enclosure breach; logs to chain.
Sensing policy gated by SOV3 Maternal Covenant: no personal biometric ID, only spatial presence + motion.
Ed25519 signing key rotates every 90 days; old key retired with hash-chained retirement record.
All POSTs append-only on UK soil (35.242.143.249); SHA-512 audit chain; GDPR Article 30 record.
24GHz mmWave operation per UK IR-2030 + ETSI EN 302 858-1 (CE); FCC 15.249 (US, gated).

assessment-activities.title: Firmware signing chain test
assessment-activities.description: Offline verifier test battery (verify_test.py): synthesize 33-byte LD2450 frame, canonical-JSON, sign with Ed25519, verify, tamper-test, wrong-key-test, 100-frame batch. All 4 must pass before bench-test.

assessment-activities.title: Care-floor policy validation
assessment-activities.description: Validate care_membrane against SOV3 charter set: no biometric identity, no track individuals, no surveillance patterns. Care-Floor 0.95 enforced at /api/verify.

assessment-activities.title: Audit chain integration
assessment-activities.description: Wire POST to UK-soil keystone: SHA-512 chain appended, 33-agent BFT signature on chain ops.

findings.title: Offline signing chain verified
findings.description: Round-trip Ed25519 sign+verify: PASS. Tamper correctly caught: PASS. Wrong-key correctly rejected: PASS. 100-frame batch: 100/100 verified.

findings.title: Care-floor validated
findings.description: Care-Membrane validated the radar's sensing policy against the SOV3 Maternal Covenant. No biometric identity, no individual tracking, no surveillance patterns. Care-Floor 0.95 enforced. PASS.

findings.title: Stage-0 firmware: bench test pending
findings.description: Hardware bench test pending printer-side assembly. Stage-0 firmware is offline-verified. Real bench test (LD2450 plugged into ESP32, captured frames vs. synthesized) is gated on Nick assembling the BOM.

assessment-results.remarks: This OSCAL assessment-results document pairs with the System Card YAML (MEOK_AssuranceRadar_System_Card.yaml) for a complete Stage-0 deliverable. Stage-0 = offline-verified firmware + signed-telemetry. Stage-1 = bench-tested with physical LD2450 sensor. Stage-2 = deployed at IOK Farm for the care-gated farm-robot pipeline. The care-gating (no individual tracking) is what makes this a care-gate sensor, not a surveillance sensor — it's the differentiator from any off-the-shelf radar.
